doc: One row per game system. crate must exist under crates/. tables must be rows of tables.json. implemented = reader/feature exists (short note); validated = checked against the user's ISO by `kh2 validate`, a test, or a kh2-game screenshot run. null = unchecked.
rows: KH2.IDX/IMG archive: hashes, LZ decompression, world sub-indexes
VIF1 unpack into VU1 memory, DMA chains, VPU packets
unit tests; tt02/tt04 + P_EX100 geometry renders
GS swizzle (PSMCT32 upload, PSMT8/PSMT4 read), CLUT addressing
tt04 + P_EX100 textures decode correctly (PNG check)
Skeletal MDLX models in rest pose (bones, weighted vertices)
MSET slots + state fallback, ANB interpolated/raw motions, F-curves, crossfades, GPU skinning
Sora/keyblade/Shadow/Soldier motions play in kh2-game (screenshots); fcurve unit tests; key times are 60 Hz ticks (fixed half-speed playback); pre/post-infinity modes
Motion triggers (range + frame) in global 60 Hz frames: hitboxes, combo/finisher windows, gravity, turn-to-lock
A300-A304 combo chains through trigger 11/50 windows; weapon trigger 10 hitboxes land
Control rig: one/two-bone IK chains, constraints (position, orientation, direction, up-vector, two-point, scale), position/rotation limiters, activations
behaviour of the game's motion evaluator, checked with kh2-ee against the user's executable
kh2 rig-sweep: all Sora forms (base/Valor/Wisdom/Limit/Master/Final/Anti), keyblade, Shadow match the game within 0.08 units; Soldier 0.15 at full arm extension (float rounding)
Rig expressions (trig in degrees, curve-at-frame, joint distance, conditionals, averages)
behaviour of the game's expression evaluator
A333 (18 expressions, 89 nodes) and Final Form E332 match the game
EE interpreter oracle: runs the game's own routines from the user's executable to check native ports
R5900 / VU user manuals; PCSX2 conventions for FPU corner cases
unit tests; runs the motion evaluator (200k instructions, 2 ms) without faults
Hit detection from objectcollision shapes + motion triggers; KH2 damage formula (atkp power, Str-Def caps, resistances)
OpenKH objectcollision.md; damage behaviour studied in the local decompilation
combo 3/2/2/1, finisher 6 vs Shadow lv1 (HP 10) match the formula (screenshots)
Sora: locomotion (prty speeds/turn), jump/fall/land, 3-hit + finisher ground combo, 4-hit + finisher air combo (hover), guard + counter, damage/blow/down/revive, lock-on, battle stance
Growth abilities: High Jump, Quick Run, Aerial Dodge, Glide from fmab rows per level (Dodge Roll is Final Mix only)
behaviour of the game's ability actions (ids 16/17/18, motions 201-208)
KH2_TRACE with KH2_GROWTH=1,1,1,1: Quick Run 30/tick ×0.94 for 14 held ticks then stop brake; High Jump 235
Magic (Fire/Blizzard/Thunder/Cure/...): motions A360-A372 exist, spells and effects not implemented
Abilities, Drive Forms, Limits, Summons, reaction commands, items
Shadow (M_EX020) + Soldier (M_EX010): models, motions, hitboxes, enmp/lvpm stats, waves
objentry, enmp ids via OpenKH EnemyNameProvider
Shadows/Soldiers spawn, chase, attack (Sora HP drops), flinch, get blown away, die (screenshots)
Enemy AI scripts (BDX) - kh2-game uses a hand-written stand-in state machine
Hit sparks, weapon trails, Heartless death effects (pax)
Map collision from COCT (stored as model space with Y and Z negated); capsule wall sliding, floors, ceilings
kh2 coct-check: COCT floors coincide with the render mesh on tt00/tt02/tt04/tt08; Sora walks tt04 streets and stairs on it (screenshots, KH2_TRACE)
Area scripts (ard): spawns, entrances, events; AI (bdx)
Music, instruments, SFX, voice (bgm, wd, seb, vag)

Player movement at 60 Hz: digital walk/run (stick 0.8), instant ground velocity, prty turn rate, analytic jump (double-sine rise, 20/49 parabola, FallMax), short hop on release, ceiling stop, air control 0.9/0.95, ledge falls, root motion
behaviour of the game's object movement and jump action (local decompilation, nothing copied)
KH2_TRACE: High Jump 1 peaks at fmab 235 above start; rise time sqrt(2h/g); combo root motion carries Sora with continuous poses
Bevy application: boots from the ISO, area switching, HUD
